answer: By the thread of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, capped per identity per epoch, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The island lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the meadow is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
